name: webshop_benchmark
description: A benchmark and simulated environment for evaluating agents in web-shop–style recommendation and shopping tasks, focusing on sequential decision making, product selection, and interactive dialogue with users. It measures an agent's ability to navigate product catalogs, ask clarifying questions, and complete purchase-oriented goals under varying user preferences and constraints.
reputation: A niche benchmark used in RL/recommendation research with modest adoption among researchers working on interactive recommendation and conversational agents.
